goal: Reduce deployed Pipeline page latency without changing eligibility, country ownership or execution checks.
steps: Profile authenticated deployed API reads without logging candidate content
Reuse configuration/profile/AI inputs and repeated decisions inside a single read-model calculation only
Add lightweight Pipeline progress polling that excludes discovery planning and document-preview work
Prevent obsolete cross-country/page responses and overlapping preview requests from repainting current controls
Verify fresh inputs on the next request, mutation isolation and country/workspace isolation; compare deployed latency and run required verification
additional_measured_bottleneck: Parallel page reads rerun existing schema/legacy-import routines and contend for SQLite write locks. Remember readiness by file identity/schema_version without caching rows or changing migrations.
data_policy: No schema changes, candidate edits, application starts, provider calls or source requests. Read-model reuse does not apply to write/execution/approval paths.
rollback: Retain current Docker image and source-only backup; data-volume restoration is not needed for this change.
